content.text:
The user wants me to create a single HTML file for a customer demographic and purchase behavior analysis dashboard. Let me design a comprehensive, visually appealing dashboard with charts and data visualizations.

I'll include:
1. Overview/KPI cards (Total Customers, Total Revenue, Avg Order Value, Repeat Rate)
2. Demographics breakdown (Age groups, Gender, Location)
3. Purchase behavior (Monthly trends, Category preferences, Spending distribution)
4. Customer segmentation
5. Geographic distribution

I'll use Chart.js for charts and create a modern, professional design. Let me build this as a single HTML file with embedded CSS and
